purpose: Requirements for doc-link formal references by document ID, link validation, path-fix notices, section IDs, change-impact candidate listing and notification, and inconsistency checks, with acceptance criteria.
summary: FR-007: formal references use reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and a DLID
FR-009: link checks search the referenced directory and verify DLID, path, relative resolution, and fragments
FR-010: path-fix notices only with a confirmed current path; doc-link never edits link definitions
Section 13.1: section IDs (DLIDs) placed at the end of every heading, issued only by the DLID assignment operation
FR-013 and FR-014: reverse lookup of referencing documents when the current hash differs from the recorded hash, notified without judging need for fixes
FR-015: notification state is not stored; the same reference is reported until the project management AI rewrites the title hash after verification
FR-016: inconsistency check list covering missing IDs, duplicates, broken references, mismatches, and hash differences
Confirmation with the user before rewriting links (D-057); doc-link itself never rewrites
Acceptance criteria AC-003 to AC-033 for path mismatch, impact listing, section scoping, and value presentation
tasks: Writing or fixing reference-link definitions with a content hash and DLID in titles
Implementing or changing the check-links skill and its link validation
Implementing or changing the check-impact skill and change-impact notification
Designing section ID assignment and section references
Handling path mismatch notices after moving or renaming documents
Rewriting title hashes after verifying referencing documents
Reviewing design documents or tests against reference and notification requirements
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
